newsitem.title: USA: Guardian to buy alarm monitoring accounts.
newsitem.headline: Guardian to buy alarm monitoring accounts.

text.p: Guardian International Inc said it has executed a letter of intent to buy about 2,200 residential and commercial alarm monitoring accounts from a Florida-based alarm company.

It said the acquisition will bring the total number of retail accounts monitored by the company to about 10,000, and increase its monthly recurring income from retail subscribers by over $60,000, or 27 percent, to about $280,000.
The purchase is subject to, among other things, due diligence and certain banking approvals and is projected to close in May or June 1997.
